Job Position: Sales Executive / Manager

Employment Type: Full-time
Business Segment: Construction Chemicals
Nationality: Nigerian

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sales Executive / Manager with proven sales experience within the construction chemicals industry in Nigeria.
	The successful candidate will be responsible for driving business development, customer acquisition, revenue growth, market expansion, and channel development for construction chemical products across Lagos and the wider Nigerian market.
	The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of the Nigerian construction chemicals market, established relationships across the construction and building materials value chain, and a demonstrable track record of delivering sales targets.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute effective sales and business development strategies for the Construction Chemicals portfolio.
	Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities across the construction, real estate, infrastructure, and building materials sectors.
	Generate qualified leads and convert prospects into long-term customers.
	Build and maintain strong relationships with contractors, developers, consultants, distributors, dealers, applicators, architects, engineers, quantity surveyors, and other key industry stakeholders.
	Achieve agreed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and revenue targets.
	Develop and manage a strong sales pipeline across Lagos and other strategic Nigerian markets.
	Conduct regular market visits to identify customer needs, competitor activities, pricing trends, market gaps, and emerging opportunities.
	Identify, onboard, and manage suitable distributors, dealers, applicators, and channel partners.
	Prepare quotations, commercial proposals, sales forecasts, customer reports, and other required documentation.
	Work closely with technical and internal teams to coordinate product demonstrations, site trials, technical presentations, and customer support.
	Provide regular market intelligence and actionable feedback on competitor products, pricing, customer requirements, and market trends.
	Support the introduction, positioning, and commercialization of new construction chemical products.
	Develop and implement market-entry strategies for new products and customer segments.
	Maintain strong after-sales relationships to drive customer satisfaction, retention, referrals, and repeat business.
	Participate in industry exhibitions, trade events, customer meetings, site visits, product launches, and technical presentations.
	Monitor customer accounts, sales performance, collections, and commercial opportunities as required.
	Represent the organization professionally and strengthen its presence within the Nigerian construction chemicals market.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
	Revenue and sales volume growth.
	New customer acquisition.
	Customer conversion and sales pipeline development.
	Distributor and dealer acquisition and development.
	Customer retention and repeat business.
	Market penetration and expansion.
	New product and market development.
	Growth of key customer and project accounts.
	Development of strategic partnerships and new business opportunities.


Requirements
Educational Qualifications:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Marketing, Business Administration, Engineering, Chemistry, Building Technology, Quantity Surveying, or another relevant discipline.
	Professional qualifications or certifications in Sales, Marketing, Business Development, Construction, or a relevant technical field will be an advantage.
	Nationality: Nigerian.


Required Experience:


	3&ndash;5 years of proven sales experience in Construction Chemicals or a closely related industry.
	Strong practical knowledge of the Nigerian construction chemicals market is essential.
	Demonstrated experience selling products such as:
	
		Waterproofing systems
		Tile adhesives and grouts
		Concrete admixtures
		Concrete repair and bonding products
		Sealants
		Protective coatings
		Industrial and decorative flooring systems
		Construction and structural repair solutions
		Other related construction chemical products.
	
	
	Demonstrable track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
	Established relationships with contractors, developers, consultants, distributors, dealers, applicators, building material merchants, and other construction industry stakeholders.
	Existing market relationships and a strong professional network within Lagos and/or other major Nigerian construction markets will be highly advantageous.
	Candidates with experience working for established construction chemical manufacturers, distributors, or suppliers in Nigeria are particularly encouraged to apply.


Required Skills &amp; Competencies:


	Strong sales, business development, and commercial skills.
	Proven ability to develop new markets and acquire customers.
	Excellent negotiation, persuasion, and closing skills.
	Strong customer relationship management capabilities.
	Good technical understanding of construction chemical products and their applications.
	Strong industry networking and stakeholder-management skills.
	Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
	Commercial awareness and ability to identify and convert revenue opportunities.
	Strong market intelligence and competitor-analysis capabilities.
	Ability to work independently, manage a sales territory, and deliver results against targets.
	Strong reporting, analytical, planning, and problem-solving skills.
	Proficiency in preparing sales proposals, quotations, forecasts, and reports.
	Willingness and ability to travel within Lagos and other parts of Nigeria as required.


Preferred Candidate Profile:


	We are particularly interested in candidates who have hands-on experience selling &nbsp;construction chemicals in Lagos and who understand how to develop business through contractors, developers, consultants, distributors, dealers, applicators, and project stakeholders.
	Candidates who have worked with or sold competing construction chemical products and have an established network within the Nigerian construction industry will be particularly relevant.
	Relevant industry exposure may include experience with established construction chemical manufacturers, suppliers, or distributors operating within the Nigerian construction chemicals sector.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and relevant technical qualifications / certifications &nbsp;to: isaac.samuel@anrml.com using &ldquo;Sales Executive / Manager&rdquo; as the subject of the email.",

Client Service Officer Job at Stanbic IBTC Bank




        
    

        
        Stanbic IBTC Bank is a leading African banking group focused on emerging markets globally. It has been a mainstay of South Africa's financial system for 150 years, and now spans 16 countries across the African continent.

Standard Bank is a firm believer in technical innovation, to help us guarantee exceptional client service and leading edge financial solutions. Our growing global success reflects our commitment to the latest solutions, the best people, and a uniquely flexible and vibrant working culture. To help us drive our success into the future, we are looking for resourceful individuals to join our dedicated team at our offices.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Client Service Officer
     

            
    



Job Locations: Ibadan - Oyo, Osun, Ogun

Job Description


	To ensure that customer service requests, complaints and queries received are acknowledged, understood and efficiently resolved within specified timelines or escalated to the appropriate area in order to deliver a positive client experience.
	To be responsible for providing specialized support and resolving complex queries and issues that frontline support personnel are unable to address and therefore can be the first point of escalation for clients and frontline staff. 


Key Responsibilities


	Attend to telephonic queries regarding cheque books.
	Receive and handle ATM cards according to laid-down policies and procedures and perform daily balancing of ATM cards in conjunction with the Asset Custodian.
	Issue off-cycle statements at customer’s instance and take charges as appropriate and keep records of all source instructions from customers.
	Identify cross-selling and migration opportunities and sell products/services reactively and participate in tactical sales/marketing activities as required.
	Attend to the posting of all value transactions within own level of authority and advice Team Leader Frontline Support to verify all value transactions posted.
	Process instructions for Cash Transfers (CT) according to laid-down policy, complete Customer Complaints Register and obtain source documents where applicable and log completed Customer Complaints on the appropriate Remedy Application on daily basis.


Requirements


	Minimum of First Degree in relevant discipline
	1–2 years of experience with the bank’s products, compliance procedures, and regulations governing financial services management.
	Previous experience in branch banking is required.


Behavioural Competencies:


	Articulating Information
	Embracing Change
	Establishing Rapport
	Following Procedures
	Managing Tasks
	Meeting Timescales
	Producing Output
	Seizing Opportunities
	Showing Composure
	Team Working
	Upholding Standards
	Valuing Individuals


Technical Competencies:


	Active Listening
	Banking Process & Procedures
	Customer Understanding (Consumer Banking)
	Product and Services Knowledge
	Product Knowledge (Consumer Banking)
	Risk Identification

Storekeeper Job at Prince O J Global Services Limited




        
    

        
        Prince O J Global Services Limited is a fast consumer goods company incorporated in Nigeria with head office in Onitsha Anambra state, We deal on importation and distribution of top quality wines and spirits, spices, tomato, spaghetti, oil, margarine, baking powder, liquid milk and many more...

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Storekeeper

Job Location: Onitsha, Anambra
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Record and keep accurate information on stock
	Oversee daily/weekly/monthly stocktaking
	Update all stock books
	Ensure goods are issued efficiently and accurately
	Prompt distribution of products to branches as requested
	Ensure there is no damage to products arising from personal handling
	Safeguard the warehouse
	Ensure adequate stock of products to avoid stock-outs
	Ensure products are picked up for delivery as and when due
	Manage the inflow and outflow of goods
	Manage the company stock system
	Other ad-hoc projects relating to stock system management

	BSc or HND in a related field
	At least 1 year of experience
	Must be computer literate
	Must reside in Onitsha
	Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
	Teamwork skills
	Attention to details
	Analytical skills.


Salary
N70,000 - N80,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position and Location as the subject of the mail.

LPG Plant Account Officer Job at Rainoil Limited




        
    

        
        Rainoil Limited is a dynamic energy company recognised for safe and sustainable operations across the downstream sector of the oil and gas industry. Specializing in the bulk storage, retail and distribution of petroleum products, our facilities include 3 ultra-modern bulk storage terminals in Lagos, Delta and Cross River State, over 190 retail stations and a fleet of over 400 distribution trucks. Established with a commitment to delivering high-quality fuel and energy solutions in Nigeria, Rainoil has grown to become a trusted name in the industry.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: LPG Plant Account Officer
Job Location: Farin Gada, Jos, Plateau
Employment Type: Contract
Specialization: LPG (Gas)

Job Summary


	To manage the petty cash inflow and outflow of Rainoil’s stations and depots as well as maintaining accurate records/books on transactions.


Roles & Responsibilities


	Facilitates the availability of funds to meet day-to-day operational petty cash expenses and emergencies.
	Maintains records to allow easy disbursement, reconciliation, and replenishment.
	Processes expense retirement ledgers to ensure proper accountability of all cash advances.
	Creates and maintains records of cash requests and disbursements.
	Reconciles all received cash, which have been recorded in the petty cash book, with expenses.
	Processes payment for accounts and issuing receipts.
	Keeps records of amounts received and paid, and regularly checking the cash balance against this record.
	Collects money from bank for safe keeping before reimbursements.
	Files all documents concerning cash payment and collection.
	Responds to queries regarding approvals, payment limits and deadlines for retirements etc.
	Retires the various imprest accounts.
	Prepares daily and weekly collections and payment summary reports for review by the station supervisor.


Requirements


	Minimum of an BSC/HND in Accounting, Banking/Finance & Economics.
	Minimum of One (1) year of work experience in a similar role.

	Attend to customers and assist them with their requests.
	Ensure customers receive the correct items.
	Assist with organizing and arranging items in the store.
	Provide excellent customer service.
	Maintain a clean and organized store environment.
	Packing Customers order accurately.

	Minimum of an SSCE / OND qualification
	Previous retail or customer service experience is an added advantage.

	Good communication and customer service skills.
	Ability to work efficiently and handle customers professionally.
	Honest, responsible, and reliable.
	Good attention to detail.
	Ability to work well with minimal supervision.


Salary
N100,000 monthly.
